# ServiceNow — captured 2026-08-14
# Family index (sources.json): www.servicenow.com/docs/r/release-notes/family-release-notes.html
#   Australia family, "Updated August 7, 2026" — UNCHANGED. Still lists AI applications as topics
#   only, with no version, GA status or feature content. Never use it to answer "did X ship?".
# Productive surfaces are the per-application pages (still not in sources.json).

## AI Control Tower (release-notes/ai-control-tower-rn.html) — now showing **Australia Patch 4**
Previously captured 2026-08-10 as the base Australia release. Patch 4 content surfaces items that
were not captured in the 2026-08-10 read:
- **Agent map visualization** — displays models, **MCP servers**, providers and workflows across the
  enterprise.                                                        [NEW — reported 2026-08-14]
- **Deduplication** — identifies redundant AI assets for consolidation.  [NEW — reported 2026-08-14]
- Service Graph Connector versions now stated: **Anthropic v2.0.7** (discovers models, tracks
  **per-user costs**), **Microsoft** (unified Azure ML config, certificate-based auth), **Amazon**
  (single credential page, automatic key rotation), **GCP Vertex AI v1.2.4 — renamed "AI Connector
  for Google"**, **Databricks (discovers AND IMPORTS AI agents)**.   [NEW detail — reported]
- "Kill switch protocol" is the Patch 4 name for the cross-cloud agent deactivation capability
  reported on 2026-08-10 (deactivate rogue agents across AWS Bedrock, GCP Vertex AI and ServiceNow).
  Same capability, new label — not re-reported.
- Carried from the 2026-08-10 report and unchanged: Activity Center; Quality & Safety monitoring with
  automated scoring and trend analysis; weighted LLM guardrail security scoring; threat metrics for
  system prompt leakage / sensitive data disclosure / injection attacks; risk heat mapping; global
  MCP clients; MCP Catalog integration; MCP server access monitoring; "External Registry"
  integration with Microsoft; risk and compliance posture reviews with regulatory classification.
- **AI Gateway remains deprecated and unsupported** in Australia.  [deprecation]

## MCP Server Console (release-notes/mcp-server-console-rn.html)
Plugin `sn_mcp_server` v1.3 — reported in full on 2026-08-10 (tools from Subflows, Actions, REST
APIs, Knowledge Graphs and Now Assist skills; embedded OAuth client registration; third-party IDP;
Quickstart Server; MCP apps). No change detected this scan.

## Held / context (unchanged)
Machine Identity Console — the identity substrate MCP Server Console depends on, genuinely outside
Zenity's coverage, but introduced in **Zurich** and only enhanced in Australia, so not a new
addition. Already GA and cached: AI Agent Advisor, Intelligent Approvals, AI Admin Center / Now
Assist Center, AI Desktop Actions, AI Agent Studio.

Note: no release family beyond Australia has appeared; upgrade paths still reference Zurich,
Yokohama and Xanadu.

Updated: 2026-08-14 — Australia Patch 4 detail on AI Control Tower; two new capabilities reported.
